build_panoptic_fpn_model: build a PanopticFPN model with backbone, neck, rpn_head, roi_head, semantic_head, and panoptic_fusion_head configs
review_PanopticFPN_init: review the PanopticFPN class __init__ to understand constructor parameters for panoptic segmentation setup
test_PanopticFPN_loss: test the PanopticFPN loss method to compute RPN, ROI, and semantic head losses during training
